metrics_finding.finding: The auth-service experienced a significant increase in mean latency (from 0.206ms to 0.560ms) and P99 latency (from 1.0s to 1.6s), indicating potential performance issues.

evidence_summary.summary: The auth-service experienced a significant increase in mean latency (from 0.206ms to 0.560ms) and P99 latency (from 1.0s to 1.6s), indicating potential performance issues.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate the cause of the increased latency in the auth-service and take corrective actions.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to performance issues in the auth-service. Further investigation is required to confirm this.
